cards.name: hero
cards.title: Content performance analysis in **4 steps**
cards.sub: Score every post against your own baseline, then change one thing on next month’s calendar.

steps.title: Awareness
steps.text: Reach, shares and follows from the post.

steps.title: Engagement
steps.text: Comments, saves and shares per reach.

steps.title: Set a baseline
steps.text: Median of your last 20 to 30 posts.

steps.title: Index and weight
steps.text: Divide by the median, weight by goal.

cards.name: mistakes
cards.title: Analysis that works, **and analysis that misleads**

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Analysis only counts when it **changes what you publish next month.**
cards.by: Do more of the winner, fix the loser, test one new idea.
